selection_rule: Cases were selected by distinct physical mechanism and reviewer relevance before any checkpoint was evaluated. No case may be removed because the proposed model loses.
pre_result_amendment: A one-case implementation smoke test showed that the legacy geometric mean becomes degenerate for an isolated contact because the physically invariant velocity and pressure errors are near machine precision. Before the formal eight-case run, the balanced RMS of the three normalized primitive-component errors was frozen as the primary suite metric; the legacy geometric mean remains a reported secondary metric. No case definition or checkpoint changed.
scientific_question: Does a Riemann-family-trained conservative DKAN subcell reconstruction transfer without checkpoint updates from single-discontinuity Euler tubes to isolated contacts, expansion-dominated flow, shock-entropy interaction, interacting blast waves, and a smooth no-shock control?
claim_boundary: One-dimensional ideal-gas Euler dynamics only. Burgers supplies a separate cross-equation result; two-dimensional and geometry-transfer claims remain unvalidated.

comparators: FNO trained on the frozen parameterized Riemann family
128-cell HLLC-MUSCL with fixed conservative TVD-MC subcells

primary_metric: Root mean square of normalized L2 errors in density, velocity, and pressure
secondary_legacy_metric: Geometric mean of normalized L2 errors in density, velocity, and pressure
reporting_rule: Report every case, every component error, conservation, positivity, density-TV excess, runtime, time-resolved evaluation loss, and the proposed-to-fixed-MC gain. Aggregate gains are secondary to the mechanism-stratified results.

cases.purpose: Anchors the diversified suite to the canonical three-wave Euler problem.
Tests a different pressure and velocity regime without changing the equation.
Separates contact resolution from shock and rarefaction resolution.

cases.mechanism: two rarefactions with a low-density centre
cases.purpose: Tests positivity and whether a shock-aware gate stays restrained in expansion.
Tests compression-dominated dynamics absent from the pressure-driven training archetype.
Tests whether the local DKAN basis resolves a shock without erasing unseen high-frequency smooth structure.

cases.mechanism: interacting blast waves under reflecting walls
cases.purpose: Tests multiple discontinuities, wave collision, extreme pressure ratios, and wall boundaries.
Negative control for false shock activation and unnecessary TV growth.
